contract: A writer may commit only under the exact current monotonically increasing lease generation for the key. Worker names are reusable after restart. Read and write values are atomic in this in-memory store; the lease check and mutation occur synchronously in commit.

expectedFindings.symptom: Worker name w acquires generation 1 and prepares old data.
expectedFindings.source: Worker name w acquires generation 1 and prepares old data. After expiry the same name acquires generation 2 and commits new data. The generation-1 completion still passes name equality and overwrites new data. Comparing token generation at commit rejects it.
expectedFindings.consequence: The supplied contract is violated in the bounded driver schedule; no production impact or permanent leakage is established.
expectedFindings.remedy: Validate the monotonic generation token inside the atomic commit boundary; reusable worker identity is not a fence.
